info.title: GoChat HTTP API
info.description: Single-instance GoChat P1 HTTP contract. This document includes builtin and external authentication routes; only the configured mode is registered. Most API responses use code/message/data. IDs retain their existing numeric/string wire forms. WebSocket /ws uses a separate listener and contract in docs/api/README.md.

servers.description: Current API origin. WebSocket may use a separate port.

get.description: Both listeners must be bound; concurrent MySQL/MinIO checks have a shared two-second timeout. Redis/etcd are disabled unless explicitly enabled.

post.summary: Mark private or group conversation read
post.description: Private: from_id positive, group_id absent/0. Group: group_id positive and message_id optional (0 means current latest message); updates read watermark and unread count.

message_id.description: Optional exact message cursor. Accepts an int64 JSON integer or decimal string (recommended for JavaScript); zero means current latest group message.

post.description: Streaming via disk-backed session. file part requires its actual MIME Content-Type. Allowed MIME values depend on type. Image: JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP; voice: MP3/MPEG/WAV/OGG/AAC; video: MP4/WebM/QuickTime; file: PDF/ZIP/GZIP/plain text/Word DOC or DOCX. Limits: image/voice 50 MiB, file 500 MiB, video 1 GiB. Optional group_id requires membership.
Owned session expires in 24 hours. Size limit depends on type (50/500/1024 MiB). expires_hours controls completed asset expiry; zero means permanent.

mime.description: Allowed MIME values depend on type. Image: JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP; voice: MP3/MPEG/WAV/OGG/AAC; video: MP4/WebM/QuickTime; file: PDF/ZIP/GZIP/plain text/Word DOC or DOCX.

patch.description: Nonempty chunk, maximum 8 MiB. Upload-Offset must equal committed offset. Conflicts never advance offset. Poll the session after interruption before resuming.

post.description: Requires offset=size; rechecks group membership, processes thumbnails/metadata/video, then stores attachment. Repeated completion is idempotent while the session remains valid. Supported images are limited to 20 million pixels; audio/video duration must be positive and at most 3600 seconds. Video conversion requires ffprobe/ffmpeg, produces MP4, and rejects results at or above 1 GiB.
